title: 5 Stocks That Have Doubled Their Dividend in the Last 7 Years to Buy in October
author: Micah Zimmerman
description: Five consumer stocks—Williams-Sonoma, Domino's Pizza, TJX Companies, Lowe's, and Costco Wholesale—have all more than doubled their dividends since 2019. Each company is backed by specific growth initiatives: Williams-Sonoma's AI shopping assistants, Domino's loyalty program expansion, TJX's off-price retail strength, Lowe's professional contractor market acquisitions, and Costco's strong membership renewal rates. However, some face headwinds like Domino's slower sales and Costco's declining comparable sales growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Dividend grew 225% since 2019; AI shopping assistants driving 700% jump in customer engagement and 620% revenue increase; raised full-year guidance.
Dividend tripled since 2019 with strong loyalty program growth (37.3M users), but facing headwinds from slower sales, inflation, and increased competition. Berkshire Hathaway divested its position.

Dividend grew 146% since 2019; 34 consecutive years of comparable sales growth; off-price retail model benefits from economic uncertainty; raised full-year profit forecast and plans expansion to 7,500 stores.
Dividend grew 143% since 2019; strategic acquisitions (Foundation Building Materials for $8.8B and Artisan Design Group for $1.325B) to capture $250B professional contractor market.

Dividend grew 126% since 2019 plus special dividends; fifth consecutive quarterly earnings beat and 92.3% membership renewal rate are positive, but underlying sales growth has slowed for three consecutive months, raising demand concerns.
